name: The Crucible of Storms
description: An open-air tower where the four elements are let in to argue. The Elementalist seat: what the guild learns of weather here, every Elementalist it fields carries into the fight.

tiers.description: Fronts: choose the element the weather favours this timeline. Every Elementalist opens each fight with 1 attunement in it. Raised once the Elementalist discipline is declared.
Standing Weather: attunement carries between the fights of one expedition at half. Needs 3 Elementalist facets.
A doctrine (free while you play Elementalist). Monoelement: bursts at 3, one element only. Or the Confluence: the third different element cast in a turn bursts for free. Needs 5 Elementalist facets.

doctrines.name: Monoelement
doctrines.description: Bursts come at 3 charges instead of 4, but only one element may hold attunement: charging one empties the rest. Pick an element and live in it.

doctrines.name: The Confluence
doctrines.description: The third different element you cast in one turn triggers that element's burst for free, and its charges stay. Weave the storm.
